cands.name: Matt Woods

money.note: Covers January 2023 on, primary and general. Party-committee lines are often in-kind staff and mail.
money.source: Alabama Fair Campaign Practices Act system, downloaded Nov 5, 2026

cands.bio: Republican state senator for District 5 since 2025 and former state representative for House District 13 (2022-2025). Co-owns Jasper Auto Sales in Jasper with his father. Holds a business administration degree from Auburn. Served on the Alabama Community College System Board of Trustees.
cands.gaps: His birthplace is not stated in the pages I could read. I found no documented positions on data centers, development or growth, or on limits on foreign or institutional land buyers. I found no stated positions on immigration or H-1B, guns, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. The campaign pages on jobs and the economy, constitutional rights and family values were not captured, so I left them out. His property-tax votes are known only from his own campaign site. I found no news reporting or controversies about him, and Ballotpedia lists no endorsements. Ballotpedia's list of bills he sponsored was empty in the page I read, so beyond his campaign site's claims I could not independently confirm what he did in office.

qual.why: Nearly four years of prior legislative service plus a business ownership and management career place him in the high band. No law, policy or budget career was found, which keeps him below the top.

end-homestead-tax.evidence: His campaign site says he voted to cap annual property tax increases and voted for the state grocery tax cut. This is his own account; I did not verify it against a roll call.

back-police-order.evidence: His campaign site says he will always defend law enforcement against those who want to defund the police, and that officers deserve respect and support.
